title: Cold Case
description:
S03 E17 — Superstar
Lilly gets new evidence in the 1973 murder of a young female tennis player who had won her high-profile match against the school's best male player just before her death.

title: Cold Case
description:
S03 E18 — Willkommen
When a theater owner discovers a .38 slug in a piece of set furniture that is not being used as a prop, Lilly and Jeffries reinvestigate a case involving the shooting of a local cabaret singer.

title: Cold Case
description:
S03 E19 — Beautiful Little Fool
A woman researching her family history learns that her great-grandmother was murdered in 1929 and the case was never solved, prompting Lilly to take a look.

title: Cold Case
description:
S03 E20 — Death Penalty: Final Appeal
Days before his scheduled execution, a man Jeffries arrested in 1994 begs him to re-examine the case.

title: Cold Case
description:
S03 E21 — The Hen House
A 1945 case involves an ambitious reporter demoted to writing trivial advice columns.

title: Charmed
description:
S07 E16 — The Seven Year Witch
Piper is attacked by demons and winds up in a coma, and as she hovers between life and death, her spirit meets Cole (Julian McMahon), who says he is trying to help restore Phoebe's faith in love.

title: Charmed
description:
S07 E17 — Scry Hard
Zankou uses his underlings to lure the sisters out of their house, so he can search for the Nexus and release the Shadow, the ultimate power.

title: Charmed
description:
S07 E18 — Little Box of Horrors
Pandora's Box falls into the hands of a shape-shifting demon (Michelle Hurd) who intends to open it and release all of its sorrows into the world, sending the sisters on a search for Hope (Brooke Nevin).

title: Charmed
description:
S07 E19 — Freaky Phoebe
A powerful sorceress (Suzanne Krull) casts a spell on Phoebe, so their souls switch bodies and Phoebe winds up trapped in the Underworld; Paige is in a quandary when her first charge (Seamus Dever) appears to be lost to the dark side.

title: Charmed
description:
S07 E20 — Imaginary Fiends
The Charmed Ones do not realize that baby Wyatt's new imaginary friend is actually the demon Vicus, who is trying to win Wyatt's trust to convert him to evil.

title: Cold Case
description:
S03 E22 — The River
A 1984 shooting case reopens when a new witness comes forward; Lilly follows a lead into the gambling world.

title: Blended
description: Soon after their blind date goes disastrously wrong, two single parents (Adam Sandler, Drew Barrymore) and their children end up sharing a suite together at an African resort.

title: Candy Cane Lane
description: A man makes a deal with a mischievous elf who casts a magic spell that brings the 12 Days of Christmas to life.

title: NHL Hockey
description:
Boston Bruins at Detroit Red Wings
The Red Wings host the Bruins in NHL regular-season play at Little Caesars Arena. Detroit snapped a five-game skid with a 2-0 road win over Tampa Bay, but Boston have won three of the last five meetings between these Atlantic Division rivals.

title: NHL Hockey
description:

From Delta Center in Salt Lake City.

title: NHL Post-Game on TNT

title: Foul Play With Anthony Davis
description:
S01 E09 — Cuban Missile Crisis
Turning the tables on the locker-room dynamic, athletes from all sports pull pranks on their teammates and sports-world friends; the team behind Impractical Jokers helps them see the prank through from the opening tip-off to the final buzzer.

title: Cold Case
description:
S03 E23 — Joseph
Lilly breaks procedural rules, putting herself and others in danger while investigating a drug counselor who was killed two days before he would testify against a student.

title: Cold Case
description:
S04 E01 — Rampage
The case of two teens who killed themselves after a murderous rampage at a mall in 1995 reopens when evidence indicates there may have been a third shooter.

title: Cold Case
description:
S04 E02 — The War at Home
A 2004 case involving the disappearance of a female war veteran reopens when her prosthetic arm is found in a river.

title: Cold Case
description:
S04 E03 — Sandhogs
Bones found in a subway tunnel are identified as those of a sandhog miner who disappeared in 1947.

title: Cold Case
description:
S04 E04 — Baby Blues
Lilly reopens a 1982 case involving a baby that died of SIDS; she investigates the baby's older brother, who believes he had something to do with the death.

title: Cold Case
description:
S04 E05 — Saving Sammy
Lilly investigates the 2003 case of an autistic boy who witnessed his parents' murder.

title: Cold Case
description:
S04 E06 — Static
When the 1958 suicide of a celebrated Philadelphia disc jockey is discovered to have been a murder, Rush and the team must find the truth of this public persona's private life.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E08 — Fire and Rain
A widow is shocked that her new "boyfriend" is the manipulative leader of a terrorist group planning an attack; Scola is reminded of his brother's death on 9/11; Tiffany worries about his emotional choices during the investigation.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E09 — Unfinished Business
After Rina is critically wounded while heading to work with Jubal, the team makes the chilling discovery that a vengeful Vargas orchestrated the shooting from behind bars and continues to target the rest of their team and their loved ones.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E10 — Fostered
As the team investigates a string of jewelry store robberies that culminate in a double murder, they uncover a connection to a 16-year-old boy trying to survive the foster care system.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E11 — Grief
The team searches for an abducted college coed; Jubal has a tense encounter with Rina's mother.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E12 — Under Pressure
Maggie goes undercover working in a bar to investigate an anti-government group that regularly gathers there; a single father on the periphery of the group begins to fear he's in danger of becoming collateral damage.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E13 — Pride & Prejudice
When a Muslim college student and his younger brother are murdered, the team connects with the outraged imam of OA's former mosque, who insists the victims were wrongly targeted as terrorists.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E14 — Ambition
The team investigates an extremist gun group after an anti-gun lobbyist building is bombed; SAC Bashar dangles a possible promotion for OA.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E15 — Scar Tissue
The team realize they have a cross-country serial killer on their hands; the case has ties to Isobel's father, Robert, and his hotel, leading to revelations about their fractured relationship.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E16 — Protective Details
After an immigration agent is fatally shot at a hockey game, the team attempts to find the shooter, who they believe may also be targeting Congressman Curtis Grange, who was at the same game.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E17 — One Night Stand
When a young couple is found murdered in a New York City park after returning from a vacation, the team searches for a suspect linked to the drug trade; Scola turns over a new leaf when it comes to his relationships.

description: The yuletide season brings headaches for Santa Claus, who bails his ne'er-do-well brother Fred out of trouble and puts him to work in his factory.

description: Adopted as a baby by one of Santa's elves (Bob Newhart), a man (Will Ferrell) leaves the workshop to search for his family in New York.

When two IRS special agents are stabbed to death in Brooklyn, the team is thrown into an investigation that leads back to the resurgence of the online conspiracy community of Duke Ducoyle, their suspect from a previous case.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E18 — Fear Nothing
OA is forced to confront one of his biggest fears when the team discovers that deadly sarin gas may have been sold to terrorists.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E19 — Face Off
When a morning show host is murdered inside her home, the team tracks the killer; things become awkward for Scola when agent Nina Chase becomes part of the team during Maggie's recovery.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E20 — Ghost From the Past
A killer is using drug mules to exploit airport security checkpoints; OA struggles to cope with the aftermath of the sarin gas exposure and the 10th anniversary of his army friend's death in Afghanistan.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E21 — Kayla
When a retired Drug Enforcement Administration agent is shot outside a bakery, the team works to determine if the victim's past cases or current bouncer job are connected to the murder; Nina and Tiffany clash over the use of an informant.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E01 — Hero's Journey
The team pivots when their sting operation to secure a massive bomb from an illegal broker leads them to discover that the device is already in the wrong hands; Jubal's promise to be present at his son's birthday party is put to the test.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E02 — Love Is Blind
When an officer is shot dead at a pawn shop along with the store's owner, the team tries to figure out why a young, recent Ivy League dropout is tied to the crime.

As the team investigates a deadly robbery, it discovers one of the perpetrators is a classmate of Jubal's son.

The team investigates a series of brutal assaults; OA hides information about his own mugging.

title: FBI

When a wealthy accountant is gunned down for secretly testifying against a notorious drug lord, the team's investigation leads Tiffany to ask for help from a friend who was formerly with the NYPD and is related to the dangerous crime boss.

After Jubal narrowly escapes a calculated assault on a secret FBI office, the team discovers a rogue terrorist group has infiltrated the FBI.

After a bomb explosion devastates a residential apartment building, special agents Maggie Bell and Omar Adom "OA" Zidan of the New York office of the FBI investigate a possible war between rival gangs.

description:

After eight people are fatally poisoned at a deli in New York City, agents Maggie Bell and OA Zidan trace the crime to an unlikely culprit and conduct a sting operation to prevent further attacks.

description:

Special agents Maggie Bell and OA Zidan join the team to investigate the murders of 18 young women, and they get help from a survivor associated with the deceased.

title: FBI

After the president of the NY Fed is gunned down trying to help a young woman in peril, the team races to find the killer and the missing woman.

When a local club owner is found dead, the team works quickly to find the motive behind the murder of a seemingly innocent man; OA is smitten with a new love interest but is concerned that she's mixed up with the wrong crowd.
